MainFile.java: This file is the main console-based to-do list application. It manages a `LinkedList<Task>` with static methods for adding, marking done, removing tasks, and displaying all or incomplete tasks. The `main` method runs an infinite loop with a menu-driven switch. It serves as the entry point and controller for the task management system.
Task.java: The `Task` class models a single to-do item with `taskName`, `deadLine`, and `isCompleted` fields. Constructor initializes a task as incomplete. Exposes getters and `setIsCompleted()` (sets to `true`). `toString()` returns a checkbox representation with name and deadline. This class serves as a core data model in the to-do list application.
README.md: This README documents a console-based Java to-do list application using `LinkedList`. It describes features (add, view, remove tasks, mark completed), setup prerequisites (JDK), compile/run commands (`javac MainFile.java`, `java MainFile`), and file structure (`MainFile.java`, `Task.java`). The README serves as a user guide and project overview, explaining how to operate the two main classes: `MainFile` (entry point) and `Task` (task definition).
